definitions.explanation: The people who make up a group, team, committee, or event. Focuses on the identity and quality of the individuals involved.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今回|こんかい}→今回：01409_konkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔|かお}ぶれ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧だ。
examples.english: The lineup this time is impressive.

examples.japanese: ⟦{委員会|いいんかい}→委員会：12234_iinkai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{顔|かお}ぶれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The members of the committee were announced.

examples.japanese: ⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{顔|かお}ぶれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{集|あつ}まる→集まる：01162_atsumaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦そろそろ→そろそろ：01259_sorosoro⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ほしい。
examples.english: The same faces gather every year, so I'd like some new members soon.

notes:
Literally "face lineup" — ⟦{顔|かお}→顔：00558_kao⟧ (face) + ⟦ぶれ→ぶれ：19846_bure⟧ (from ⟦{触|ふ}れ→触れる：01984_fureru⟧, announcement/display). Focuses on who the people are rather than how many there are.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{豪華|ごうか}→豪華：02815_gouka⟧な{顔|かお}ぶれ (an impressive/star-studded lineup)
- ⟦{同|おな}じ→同じ：02857_onaji⟧{顔|かお}ぶれ (the same faces/people)
- {顔|かお}ぶれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{揃|そろ}う→揃う：01953_sorou⟧ (the members are all assembled)
- {顔|かお}ぶれ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧ (the lineup changes)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦メンバー→メンバー：00275_menbaa⟧ is a neutral term for members
- {顔|かお}ぶれ emphasizes the identities and often implies a notable or scrutinized group
